description: Works out where the user stands in one course and what they need on the remaining work to reach a target grade. Returns the current percentage, the best and worst possible final grade, and the average they must score on everything left to hit targetPercent. Use for "can I still pass?" or "am I on track?". For the raw grade items, use get_my_grades instead. Example: "What do I need on the final to get an 80?"

targetPercent.description: The final grade the user wants, as a percentage (for example 80). Omit to just get the current standing and best/worst case.

totalWeight.description: Total weight of the course. Almost always 100.

name: get_grade_outlook
title: Grade Outlook And Target Calculator
